Plan overview:
- We will produce an operator-signer roster PDF (signed by Redwood) that lists the names, badge IDs, and crypto thumbprints for on-site acceptance.
- The firmware bundle will be signed with an offline signing key stored in an HSM (YubiHSM/CloudHSM export token format). The signing artifact will include a detached signature (you already received .sig) and an embedded signing certificate chain.
- Courier handoff: BlueFreight will receive the sealed media from Redwood Secure Logistics. The manifest will include SHA256 + an HSM-signed manifest certificate.

Immediate action items for us (to confirm):
1) Marissa — procurement: finalize courier SOW and confirm insurance/escrow fees by EOD 11/19.
2) Karthik — ops: please prepare the offline verification checklist and the step-by-step HSM import procedure (minimal operator interactions, explicit acceptance prompts, and rollback commands).
3) Avery — can you confirm the identity verification method your operators will use (badge + OTP or badge + phone code)? We will include the expected ID fields in the roster.

Acceptance criteria for activation: 
- Manifest SHA256 matches on-site artifact before import.
- Operator roster names match IDs presented.
- HSM import completes and Redundant-Hash verification passes.
- A short smoke test (checksum + boot verification) completes within the window.

I'll attach the roster and checklist drafts once Karthik and Marissa update them.

Regards,
